jobs.title: Software Development Engineer I, Annapurna Labs, Early Career - 2027
jobs.description: At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you. What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus. About the team Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon at Amazon - including Graviton (our server processors), Trainium and Inferentia (our machine learning training and inference accelerators), and the Nitro system that powers modern EC2. We own the full stack, from silicon through the software that makes it work (compilers, runtimes, drivers, and the frameworks that let customers run workloads on our hardware). As a Software Development Engineer I, you'll write the software that turns custom silicon into products used by millions. Where you might land: Annapurna has software teams spanning the full stack, and we work to place you on a technical team aligned with your interests and strengths. Example teams and focus areas include: - Compiler development for ML accelerators (Neuron SDK, MLIR, LLVM) - ML runtimes and frameworks (integration with PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow) - Low-level systems software, firmware, and device drivers - Performance optimization and kernel development for custom silicon - Distributed training and inference infrastructure Once you join, we partner with you and our hiring managers to match you to a team where your background and interests fit best, so your project is something you're genuinely excited to work on. As an SDE I, you'll contribute to real production software, which may include: - Designing, implementing, and testing software across the stack - from low-level systems code to compilers, runtimes, and tooling - Writing efficient, maintainable code in languages such as C, C++, or Python - Optimizing software performance on custom hardware (Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia) - Debugging complex issues across the hardware-software boundary - Collaborating with hardware, compiler, and systems teams to deliver features end-to-end - Documenting your work and presenting results to the team - Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with a final graduation date of May 2027 or later - Programming experience in at least one modern language such as C, C++, Java, or Python - Coursework or project experience in data structures, algorithms, and software design - Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: operating systems, computer architecture, or systems programming - Bachelor's or Master's degree with a focus on systems, compilers, computer architecture, or high-performance computing - Experience with low-level or systems programming in C/C++ (memory management, concurrency, performance optimization) - Familiarity with compilers (MLIR, LLVM, TVM), ML runtimes, operating systems internals, or distributed systems - Exposure to machine learning frameworks and an understanding of how models run on hardware - Prior internship, research, or open-source contribution experience in systems, compilers, or ML infrastructure Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The starting pay for this position is listed below. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits . jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Shopping Videos (Ads)
jobs.description: Amazon Shopping Video (ASV) is a new strategic program in Amazon Advertising that leverages the potential of video to help millions of customers find product inspiration through videos. ASV is seeking a *self-driven*, enthusiastic full stack engineer with a *strong* product sense to help accomplish our mission! We are looking for a strong full stack engineers to design, lead and build E2E video experiences (low-latency rendering and responsive, modern CX) used by millions of customers. In this role, you'll have significant influence on the team's technical direction and engineering practices. In this role, you will lead and work in niche areas like livestreaming, chat, advertising and video commerce where you will have the opportunity to innovate solving technical problems that are unique and rewarding. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who likes to deliver in a fast-paced environment to demonstrate impact that will enable the explosive growth of video in Amazon. In an AI-Native development world, engineers who love to be multi-disciplinary by developing products and influence key product/business decisions will thrive in this role. Key job responsibilities - Build lovable, fluid customer experiences to delight customers to view videos and shop as they watch videos working with a cross-functional group of Engineers, UX + Product team, Applied Scientists, Marketing. - Lead a group of Engineers on complex projects that millions of Amazon Customers interact with every day. - Expertise in modern architecture patterns, state management, and component-based design. - Experience with design system implementation and component libraries. - Takes lead of projects E2E, including taking decisions wearing Product/UX hat. - Experience with performance optimization for high-frequency UI updates and complex state changes. - Knowledge of accessibility standards and internationalization best practices. - Work on a wide breadth of tech (optimize video recommendations, build low-latency rendering systems and responsive, modern CX) A day in the life You'll work with a cross-disciplinary team to design and implement Video experiences. Self-driven engineers will enjoy the autonomy to impact millions of customers regularly. Engineers who love to be multi-disciplinary (routinely influence and take UX/Product decisions). About the team The team works like a startup with individuals owning not just the tech, but also business goals that drive impact partnering with Product Managers. Engineers have access to leaders on a regular basis to present, brainstorm their ideas to drive impact to customers. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave.
